overview_description.description: myZoi is a fintech company focused on financial inclusion for underbanked workers, offering digital payroll solutions, remittances, and financial literacy tools. It enables employers to pay salaries digitally while helping employees access secure wallets, lower-cost money transfers, and better financial management services. The platform is designed to improve access to banking services, reduce transaction costs, and support migrant workers and their families with more transparent, efficient, and accessible financial systems.

product.name: myZoi Digital Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet that allows users to store electronic money and perform various financial transactions through the myZoi Mobile App.

product.name: myZoi Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application designed to run on various mobile operating systems, providing access to myZoi's financial services.

product.name: myZoi Debit Card
product.description: A prepaid or debit card issued by myZoi, enabling users to withdraw money from their digital accounts at selected ATMs or make purchases at accepted locations.

product.name: Fund Transfer
product.description: A service that allows users to transfer money from their myZoi account to a beneficiary.
